privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Information about collection and processing of personal data

collect.title: What Data We Collect
collect.content:
When using the site, we may collect the following information:
• Email address (during registration or form submission)
• Name and contact details (when filling out forms)
• Data from OAuth providers (GitHub, Google, Yandex) during authorization
• Technical information (IP address, browser type, cookies)

use.title: How We Use Data
use.content:
Collected data is used for:
• Providing access to site features
• Contacting you regarding requests and inquiries
• Improving service quality
• Sending notifications (with your consent)

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content:
The site uses cookies for:
• Maintaining authorization sessions
• Remembering preferences (language, theme)
• Traffic analytics

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content:
We use the following third-party services:
• OAuth providers (GitHub, Google, Yandex) for authorization
• Analytics systems to improve service
• Email services for sending notifications

security.title: Data Security
security.content:
We take measures to protect your data:
• Encryption of transmitted data (HTTPS)
• Secure password storage
• Limited access to personal data

services.title: Description of Services
services.content:
kami.letar.best is a personal portfolio website of a software architect. The site provides:
• Information about skills and experience
• Blog with technical articles
• Forms for contact and service requests
• Authorization system for extended features
